**daemon:** the socket, pid and lock files no longer follow `TMPDIR` on macOS (shells with different `TMPDIR` started two daemons for one repository): they live in `XDG_RUNTIME_DIR` when set, else `~/.cache/pixel/sockets/` (0700), and a path over the `sockaddr_un` limit moves to a short `/tmp/pixel-<hash>/` directory. A daemon from before the upgrade keeps its old socket, is no longer found, and idles out; the next call starts a new one.
